GuaranteeStrip.text: This rental is covered by Road Assurance: 24/7 support, towing, replacement car.

BookingSummary.title: Booking Summary
BookingSummary.intro: Check everything once more. Nothing is charged until you go to payment.
BookingSummary.noHidden: No hidden fees: the total is the sum of the lines above.
BookingSummary.payNote: You will be asked to sign in before paying; your choices are kept.

missing.title: Booking details are missing
missing.text: Start again by choosing a car, a branch and dates.

error.title: Booking summary could not be loaded
error.text: We cannot fetch the details right now. Please try again.

extras.intro: Add them if you like; what you pick shows in the total straight away.

BookingSummary.vatNote: Prices include VAT. There is no extra charge for returning at a different branch.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.intro: The last step to complete your booking.
Payment.demoText: Nothing is charged. Your card details are not stored or sent to a server; do not enter a real card.
Payment.demoHint: Demo card: 4242 4242 4242 4242, any valid date and any CVC.

errors.holder: Enter the name on the card.
errors.unavailable: The booking service is not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.invalid: The booking details are not valid. Please start the search again.
errors.signin: You need to sign in to continue.
errors.generic: The booking could not be completed. Please try again.

Confirmation.title: Your booking is confirmed
Confirmation.text: The demo payment is complete; no real amount was charged.

missing.title: No booking to confirm
missing.text: You get to this page after making a booking.

Confirmation.points: This rental earns you {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}.

expired.title: Time is up
expired.text: The time we hold the car for you has run out and it is available again. You can go back to the same search and choose it again.

taken.title: This car was just rented
taken.text: Another customer took the car while you were paying. You can look at the other cars in the same search.

HoldCountdown.label: We are holding your car. Time left:
HoldCountdown.lastMinute: Less than a minute is left on the hold.
